def feats(inp):
    res=[]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    for r in range(7):
        for c in range(7):
            v=inp[r][c]
            if v in (0,1): continue
            n=cnt[v]
            res.append((r,c,v,n))
    return res
FD={
 'v%3':lambda r,c,v,n:v%3, 'v//3':lambda r,c,v,n:v//3, '(v-1)//3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v-1)//3,
 'r%3':lambda r,c,v,n:r%3, 'r//3':lambda r,c,v,n:r//3, 'c%3':lambda r,c,v,n:c%3, 'c//3':lambda r,c,v,n:c//3,
 '(r+c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(r+c)%3, '(r-c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(r-c)%3, 'n%3':lambda r,c,v,n:n%3, 'n':lambda r,c,v,n:n%3,
 '(v+c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v+c)%3, '(v-c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v-c)%3, '(v+r)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v+r)%3, '(v-r)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v-r)%3,
 '(v*n)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v*n)%3, '(r*n)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(r*n)%3, '(c*n)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(c*n)%3,
 '(r+c+n)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(r+c+n)%3, '(v+r+c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v+r+c)%3,
 '(v+r-c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v+r-c)%3, '(v-r+c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v-r+c)%3,
 '(r+2*c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(r+2*c)%3, '(2*r+c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(2*r+c)%3,
 'r*3//7':lambda r,c,v,n:r*3//7, 'c*3//7':lambda r,c,v,n:c*3//7,
 '(v*3//7)':lambda r,c,v,n:v*3//7,
 '(v+2*r)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v+2*r)%3, '(v+2*c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v+2*c)%3,
 '(v-2*r)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v-2*r)%3, '(v-2*c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(v-2*c)%3,
 '(2*v+r)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(2*v+r)%3, '(2*v+c)%3':lambda r,c,v,n:(2*v+c)%3,
}
keys=list(FD)
hits=[]
for kr,kc in itertools.product(keys,keys):
    fr,fc=FD[kr],FD[kc]
    ok=True
    for inp,out in demos:
        T={(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if out[i][j]==8}
        Sp={(fr(*f),fc(*f)) for f in feats(inp)}
        if Sp!=T: ok=False;break
    if ok: hits.append((kr,kc))
print(hits)
